thread:
elaine: Quick heads up — please HOLD the Optimize benchmark blog scheduled for 12:00 PDT. I spotted inconsistent latency numbers for long-context runs in the final CSV.

mike-eng: Oof. Which metric? p50/p95 or the per-token spec?

elaine: p95 for 8k/32k context on Dedicated. The CSV used a mixed batch config by mistake (batch=4) while the text in the doc references single-request latencies.

sam-marketing: Noted. publish-bot shows a scheduled publish at 12:00. Can we delay at source quickly? @deploy-bot?

publish-bot: Scheduled post "Optimize: Cut inference cost by 3x" — publish window 2026-07-23 19:00 UTC (12:00 PDT).

deploy-bot: Hold request received. Canceling scheduled publish job ID 98765. ETA to revert: <1m.

devon-analyst: I pulled the CSV — confirmed the mixup. There's a separate run with batch=1 in s3://benchmarks/optimize/final/ but the blog linked the wrong file. I can regenerate the charts in ~20m if we allow me a small sandbox window.

mike-eng: Thanks Devon. Also need to re-run the 32k runs with pinned tensor-core kernels. I can kick those off now (queue 2x A100s). Expect ~18m for completion. I'll push corrected CSV to the same s3 path with suffix _v2.

elaine: OK. Sam, we need to update the headline numbers, the chart labels, and the tweet copy. Can we move the publish target to 13:30 PDT to be safe?

sam-marketing: Yes, let's aim for 13:30 PDT. I'll update the CMS draft once we have the new charts. Can someone add a short note for PR to explain the delay to any reporters on the embargo list?

nina-pr: I can draft a neutral line: "We delayed publication to ensure accuracy after an internal data reconciliation; corrected numbers are now reflected in the post." Will wait for final CSV. Also pinging @press-channel with a short heads-up.

devon-analyst: Uploading interim CSV now to s3://benchmarks/optimize/final/optimize_bench_v2.csv and regenerating charts.

mike-eng: 32k reruns started: job IDs 5512, 5513. I will annotate the runs with the kernel flags used.

publish-bot: Publish job 98765 canceled. New reserved slot for marketing: 2026-07-23 20:30 UTC (13:30 PDT) pending manual trigger.

sam-marketing: Thanks all. I'll hold the front-page share and socials until Nina gives the signoff. Please add any short blurb to the PR chain if you edit the post. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/content/pull/1478

elaine: Appreciate the quick reactions. Dev/Eng: ping here when charts are uploaded. PR owners: DO NOT merge until we confirm signoff.

nina-pr: Will sign off after I see the updated chart images and a one-line QA from Dev/Eng confirming the numbers are final.

mike-eng: Charts uploaded to PR as assets; added a short note in the PR description about kernel flags and batch config.

devon-analyst: Final CSV checksum: sha256:3fa4b2c5... uploaded. Charts regenerated and attached.

sam-marketing: Reviewed. Updating CMS and tweet copy now. New draft headline: "Optimize: 3x lower per-token cost in long-context serving (updated)" — keeping the parenthetical updated so it’s clear to internal reviewers.

nina-pr: Approved. You can go live at 13:30 PDT. Sending embargo note to reporters now.

publish-bot: Manual publish scheduled for 2026-07-23 20:30 UTC by @sam-marketing.

elaine: Great job team. After publish, let's do a quick retro to tighten the CSV->doc mapping to prevent this slipping again. :thumbsup:
